items.description: Recovery of stolen bicycle incl. locksmith call-out and lock cutting (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.2(a),(b), but bike is unscheduled so 4.2.2 mobility sub-limit of EUR 500 applies in aggregate, shared rateably. Est. fair value ~450 of ~1150 total gives about 195.

items.description: Repair of theft damage to frame and brakes (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Repair cost under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b), within mobility class; rateable share of EUR 500 sub-limit. Est. fair ~500 of ~1150 gives about 220.
Labour and sundries follow the covered work under 7.1.7(d),(e) and 5.2.2(b); rateable share of sub-limit. Est. fair ~200 of ~1150 gives about 85.
